caption: The drawing depicts two objects, both rendered in shades of blue and grey against a light beige background. On the left side, there is a pair of ornate tongs with circular finger holes at the top, a decorative circular medallion in the middle, and slender handles ending in claw-like pincers. To the right of the tongs, there is a lidded urn or sugar bowl with two intricate, curving handles on either side. The bowl is rounded, sits on three scroll-like legs, and has a domed lid topped with a spherical knob. The shading and lines provide depth and suggest a metallic texture. Both objects are detailed with fine linework and highlights, and "M.A.R.S." is inscribed in small letters below the urn.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl and Tongs
